properties.name: Serving and transport
properties.purpose:
How the surface is actually reached: the service that answers, the process entry point, the MCP-over-HTTP primitives, the stdio-to-HTTP session proxy, the shared-mode manager, and the registry that maps a graph_id to an open design.

These are the parts that would still exist if every tool were deleted — the machinery of BEING a server, distinct from WHAT is served.
